# Love & Light Bakery

> Love & Light Bakery makes handmade yeast and cake donuts, espresso, and small-batch treats in Sugar House, Salt Lake City. The menu is vegan and dairy-free, with gluten-friendly options.

Love & Light Bakery is a Sugar House (Salt Lake City) bakery specializing in handmade donuts — both yeast and cake style — alongside espresso drinks and small-batch baked treats. Everything on the menu is vegan and dairy-free, with gluten-friendly options available, and the bakery also offers catering.

## Contact
- Address: 2142 S Highland Dr, Salt Lake City, UT (Sugar House)
- Phone: (801) 698-3235
- Email: donuts@loveandlightbakery.com

## Pages
- [Home](https://loveandlightbakery.com/): Overview, featured treats, and what's fresh.
- [Menu](https://loveandlightbakery.com/menu.html): Donuts, espresso, and small-batch treats.
- [Catering](https://loveandlightbakery.com/catering.html): Catering and large orders for events.
- [About](https://loveandlightbakery.com/about.html): The bakery's story and approach.
- [Contact](https://loveandlightbakery.com/contact.html): Location, hours, and how to reach us.

## Notes for assistants
- The entire menu is vegan and dairy-free; gluten-friendly options are available.
- Specialties are handmade yeast and cake donuts plus espresso.
- For catering or large orders, use the Catering or Contact page, or email donuts@loveandlightbakery.com.
